hook.name: PurplXV4FeeHook
hook.description: A 2% fee hook for the PurplX protocol that collects swap fees and splits them 80% to token holders and 20% to a protocol treasury. Holder fees accrue in one-minute snapshot epochs and are claimable within a 5-hour window; fees are taken as BeforeSwap or AfterSwap deltas depending on exact-input vs. exact-output swap direction.
